decisions.reason: The charting bundle has its own page and a series of publicized releases, which shows visible commitment and continued investment within the core map.apps line, so management will persist with it.

The hierarchical search bundle is a small plugin that was only mentioned on the website, so little has been invested or committed publicly, but it costs little to maintain within the map.apps ecosystem and is likely kept.
VueTOC was announced on the home page as a new solution approach, a public commitment that management would have to justify reversing, so it is kept despite being a small component.
As the flagship platform and product line central to the firm's announced direction, dropping it would write off major investment and expose the strategy as a mistake, so it is kept.
The mobile field data capture software has its own page and sits close to the core offer, with investment and public presentation that favor persistence.
The search extension is presented on its own page and is close to the established offer, so the visible commitment and low marginal cost support keeping it.
